Urban Company

1. Quarter & context
Urban Company – Q2 FY26 performance update with focus on India, International, Native and InstaHelp.

Core Financials

2. Net Transaction Value (NTV):
NTV stood at ₹1,080 crore, growing ~31% YoY.

3. Revenue from operations:
Revenue grew ~37% YoY to ₹380 crore.

4. Annual Transacting Users (ATU):
ATUs increased to ~74 lakh.

5. Monthly Active Service Professionals:
Monthly active service professionals reached ~57,251.

Profitability & EBITDA

6. Adjusted EBITDA losses:
Adjusted EBITDA loss was ~₹35 crore, largely due to investments in InstaHelp.

7. InstaHelp drag:
Out of total EBITDA loss, ~₹44 crore was attributable to the new vertical InstaHelp.

8. Near-term outlook:
Consolidated EBITDA losses are expected to continue in the near term due to meaningful investments in InstaHelp.

Operating Metrics (Q2 FY25 → Q2 FY26)

9. Annual transacting users:
• Q2 FY25: 63.21 lakh
• Q2 FY26: 74.08 lakh

10. Total orders:
• Q2 FY25: 59 lakh
• Q2 FY26: 74 lakh

11. Average Order Value (AOV):
• Increased from ₹1,320 → ₹1,386

12. Monthly active service professionals:
• Increased from 42,187 → 57,251

Revenue Mix

13. Services revenue:
Services contributed ₹251 crore.

14. Products (B2B2C):
Products (B2B2C) contributed ₹54 crore.

15. Products (Native):
Native products contributed ₹75 crore.

16. Total revenue reconciliation:
₹251 cr + ₹54 cr + ₹75 cr = ₹380 crore

India Consumer Services Business

17. NTV growth:
India consumer services NTV grew ~19% YoY.

18. Revenue growth:
Revenue grew ~24% YoY.

19. Core category traction:
Healthy traction continues in cleaning, beauty & repairs.

20. Revamp initiative:
New wall decor solution “Revamp” is showing encouraging early signs.

Margins & Investments

21. Margin compression:
Margins declined from 8.1% → 2.4% YoY, driven by deliberate investments.

22. Areas of investment:
• Training infrastructure & trainers
• Audits & quality control
• Customer support & service professional support
• Brand-led new user acquisition
• Faster fulfilment
• Technology & AI

23. Margin guidance:
Management targets steady-state adjusted EBITDA margin of 9–10% of NTV.

Partner Enablement

24. Preventing disintermediation:
Urban Company invested in welfare initiatives for service professionals including:
• 2-wheelers for women
• Insurance
• Scholarships for children
• Soft loans

25. Partner earnings (FY25):
Average monthly net earnings after deductions stood at ~₹26,400.

Gross Margin Profile

26. Products (B2B2C):
Gross margin ~28%.

27. Products (Native):
Gross margin ~44%.

InstaHelp (New Vertical)

28. Order scale comparison:
• Core India services took ~4.5 years to reach 4.6 lakh orders
• InstaHelp reached ~4.86 lakh orders in just 8 months

29. Market presence:
InstaHelp currently operates in Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Kolkata & Pune.

30. Growth outlook:
Continued investments planned to scale InstaHelp; early traction is strong.

International Business (UAE & Singapore)

31. International performance:
International operations achieved adjusted EBITDA breakeven in the quarter.

32. Future monitoring:
Management will track sustainability over the next 2 quarters.

33. Long-term expectation:
Adjusted EBITDA margins for international business expected to be similar to India over time.

Native Business (Own Brands)

34. NTV growth:
Native NTV grew ~164% YoY to ₹97 crore.

35. Revenue growth:
Revenue grew ~179% YoY to ₹75 crore.

36. Margin improvement:
EBITDA margins improved from -80% of NTV to -9%, indicating a clear path to profitability.

37. Growth moderation:
Growth will remain healthy but may moderate due to higher base and focus on profitable growth.

38. Active hours per professional per month
• FY22: 59 hours
• FY25: 83 hours
• H1 FY26: 89 hours

39. Competition:
Competition in InstaHelp is expected primarily from Snabbit and Pronto.

Concall Insights (Overall)

40. Ex-InstaHelp performance:
Excluding InstaHelp, the business delivered adjusted EBITDA of ~₹10 crore.

41. Native demand drivers:
Strong demand in water purifiers, electronic door locks, etc.

42. Seasonality impact:
Demand pulled forward due to festive season; growth may temper in coming quarters.

43. International growth:
• NTV up ~78% YoY to ₹160 crore
• Revenue up ~66% YoY to ₹41 crore

44. Near-term losses:
Company may report EBITDA losses at consolidated level for a few quarters due to heavy investments.

Summary Takeaway

45. Big picture:
• Core India services remain profitable
• International business at breakeven
• Native moving rapidly towards profitability
• InstaHelp driving near-term losses but scaling extremely fast
• Long-term EBITDA margin target remains 9–10% of NTV
